verdict.rationale: Brex's docs reference an 'openapi' URL structure (e.g. developer.brex.com/openapi/webhooks_api.md) implying spec-based documentation, but a direct probe for standard machine-readable spec files (openapi.json, swagger.json, etc.) returned 404 on all candidate paths, meaning no downloadable OpenAPI spec is actually accessible. missing for 10: a working link to a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON or YAML file, confirmation that the 'openapi' folder pages are anything more than rendered markdown docs.
